data.exact_reserve_text: Gross claims development as at 31 December 2015
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross claims reserve release of GBP 6.601 million for the 2013 underwriting year, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This release is attributed to favorable claims experience developing within conservative loss ratios and the absence of significant natural perils losses. The 2013 year of account was closed by reinsurance to close at 31 December 2015.
raw_causal_phrases: the result continues to unwind with the claims experience developing within the conservative loss ratios included in the syndicate plan
in the absence of natural perils losses of any significance

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development percentage could not be calculated against total opening reserves as the development was specific to the 2013 underwriting year, while opening reserves are for all years combined. No specific named events were mentioned as impacting claims development. LOB specific prior year movements could not be determined from the available data.
